title: Ferric Warbringer
summary: Ferric Warbringer is a powerful Draco-Titan. As soon as he is unleashed, he rushes through the battlefield and fights his way through enemy lines with his vast arsenal of weaponry.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Ferric Warbringer once fought against a [[Feyone]] [[Titan]]. Her Seeker used [[TCG:SAS-119|Switchsoul]] to get to know Ferric Warbringer's strengths and weaknesses. {{source|TCG:SAS-119|SAS-119}}
sections.text: Ferric Warbringer once fought against a Feyone Titan. Her Seeker used Switchsoul to get to know Ferric Warbringer's strengths and weaknesses. [TCG:SAS-119]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Covered in sharp spikes, Ferric Warbringer never runs out of weapons. Besides impaling his enemies or slicing them with his pole-axe, Ferric Warbringer can turn berserk at any moment which causes him to rage, making it a lot harder for his enemies to defeat him.

full_text:
Ferric Warbringer is a powerful Draco-Titan. As soon as he is unleashed, he rushes through the battlefield and fights his way through enemy lines with his vast arsenal of weaponry.

== History ==
Ferric Warbringer once fought against a Feyone Titan. Her Seeker used Switchsoul to get to know Ferric Warbringer's strengths and weaknesses. [TCG:SAS-119]

== Abilities ==
Covered in sharp spikes, Ferric Warbringer never runs out of weapons. Besides impaling his enemies or slicing them with his pole-axe, Ferric Warbringer can turn berserk at any moment which causes him to rage, making it a lot harder for his enemies to defeat him.
